name: 应龙
scope: Medium generation specifications only; parent submits API calls and separately reviews downloaded models. No runtime or readiness change.

source.text: 大荒東北隅中，有山名曰凶犁土丘。應龍處南極，殺蚩尤與夸父，不得復上，故下數旱。旱而為應龍之狀，乃得大雨。
應龍已殺蚩尤，又殺夸父，乃去南方處之，故南方多雨。
黄帝乃令應龍攻之冀州之野。應龍畜水。

boundaries: Do not join East and North entries into one quote.

The main text does not enumerate legs, claws, horns, scales, wing count or body length.

inferred.item: Elongated dragon with complete dragon head and tail, no native limbs or horns
inferred.basis: A restrained serpentine design choice, not an explicit limb count; scaled muzzle, brows, short whiskers, proportions and tapered tail are artistic completion.

有翼 derives from Guo commentary only. Two shoulder attachments, feathers, scale-to-covert transition and wing size are design choices. One wing mother is replicated twice by proper rotations, never negative scale.

inferred.item: Blue-green, pale belly, ivory wings and open shallow-S pose
inferred.basis: Palette and pose are inferred. Open pose is a generation/rigging choice; wind, rain and wave motion need later design and verification.

currentModel.evidence: Research commit is source/blocker work, not a dragon asset. Previously reviewed isolated HIGH feather wing/tail do not establish a complete dragon. No fresh model exists in this specification task; old inventory is not re-audited here.

acceptance: Review body and wing independently with actual four orthographic views using Read before any assembly or High decision.
Complete credible dragon head, neck, rounded trunk, continuous belly and entire tapered pointed tail; no ouroboros, welded end, loop, missing tip or flattened tail slab.
Body shoulder volume must support two deep organic wing-root overlaps; no native wing remnants, socket holes, pegs or visible collars.
Wing root, elbow and separate feather silhouette must be volumetric on both sides; no stump, folded ball, flat mounting plate or torn tips.
Assembled beast has exactly two inferred wings and one body/head/tail; inspect root coverage through full wing range before acceptance.

Later production requires finite skinned geometry, full-body clearance or actual belly contacts, idle/walk/special continuous captures, source/inferred card checks, StrictMode lifecycle and special return. Prepared tasks imply none of those passes.
